verdict.rationale: Lovable documents programmatic ways to drive it. An official Lovable MCP server lets an AI agent create projects, send messages, inspect code and deploy apps. The "Lovable API Build with URL" feature opens Lovable with a prefilled prompt via a link. However, no conventional public REST API is evidenced, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose REST/HTTP API with a published spec, API auth/key documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic control.
